steps: Shut off the water supply to the irrigation system at the backflow valve.
Turn off the automatic controller or set it to 'rain mode' / off.
Open drain valves on the system if it has manual drains.
For systems without drains, a pro uses an air compressor to blow out remaining water (recommended, since DIY blow-outs risk pipe damage from over-pressurizing).
Insulate the backflow preventer with a foam cover.
